interpretation.operationalReplacementChoice: The scientific stopping contract permits at most one precommitted whole-superblock technical replacement. This executable v5.0 package elects the stricter zero-replacement fail-stop policy; it does not expand, weaken, or silently exercise that optional allowance.
interpretation.timeouts: A timeout is a terminal technical failure of the active execution attempt and never authorizes retry, resume, top-up, merge, skip, reorder, or parallel completion.
interpretation.targetHostRecheck: All resource limits and free-space requirements must be rechecked before any later collection authorization.
